workedExamples.prompt: Compare “badge”, “page”, “catch” and “duck”. What should a reader identify?
workedExamples.solution: Identify -dge, -ge, -tch and -ck respectively, then read each whole word.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner swaps two endings. What should be checked?
